notes.title: New Version 1.4
notes.notes:
- 30% more character health
- More burgers and bottles on the first levels

notes.title: New Version 1.3. Release Notes:
notes.notes:
- The character doesn’t stagger so much when walking.
- Added a burger and a bottle to level 3.
- Made level 2 design more obvious.

- Added a hint. Move List.

- Character stopping faster
